decisions.title: Name of the resource (the Vein)
decisions.summary: Placeholder is 'the Vein'. Rename when the world has more shape.

decisions.title: Depletion crisis — who knows the causal mechanism
decisions.summary: Coalition extraction reduces field intensity, lowering the biological barrier. Who has understood this causal link, named it institutionally, or is suppressing it?
decisions.decided_text: The causal mechanism is not understood institutionally by either faction. The Order experiences depletion as instinctual range-expansion pressure — practitioners must seek viable concentrations further afield — without a causal account of why. The Coalition understands site depletion operationally (yield curves, diminishing returns) but has not connected extraction to barrier erosion on the Order side. A handful of frontier-knowledge individuals on both sides have independently arrived at a more complete picture and hold it privately; neither institution has surfaced it. The crisis is slow and not yet acute. This latent distributed knowledge makes the mechanism discoverable by story characters without requiring institutional acknowledgment or first-discovery as a plot event.

decisions.title: Depletion crisis — public acknowledgment level
decisions.summary: Is the full implication of extraction-driven barrier erosion publicly acknowledged, officially denied, or institutionally undiscovered?
decisions.decided_text: Neither faction has publicly named the depletion problem. No official position exists because no institution has formed one. Citizens on both sides experience effects — Order practitioners ranging further, Coalition sites yielding less — and attribute them to war conditions, natural variation, or expansion opportunity. The crisis is a pure institutional blind spot at the public level. The handful of frontier-knowledge individuals established in D002 hold their understanding privately; it has not surfaced into any public discourse on either side.

decisions.title: Substrate recovery — observed by anyone?
decisions.summary: Geological re-saturation of depleted substrate is mechanically established. Has anyone kept records long enough to observe it, and what did they do with that knowledge?
decisions.decided_text: Substrate recovery is real but not empirically observed by anyone — timescales are too long and no site has been left fully undisturbed long enough to test it. The Order holds a general death doctrine: all Order people return to the Vein in death. Attuned practitioners carry a layered version — they believe they go to a better place within that return, intuited from their lived connection to the Vein; the depth of their felt relationship to the field in life makes reunion feel qualitatively different to them. Neither tier is a physical hypothesis. Both are belief structures that inadvertently encode the recovery mechanism as spiritual doctrine without recognizing it as such. The religious arm carries this as death doctrine. The Order hierarchy reinforces it naturally: deep attunement in life maps to elevated return in death, which supports the entire social order. The Coalition has no equivalent intuition — their extractive framework has never produced a concept of recovery.

decisions.title: Refined substrate appearance and properties
decisions.summary: Coalition processing produces a grade range across four independent axes: concentration (Vein per unit volume), size (element scale and form), shape (internal mirror face coherence), and matter form (resting phase state before activation). Each axis has its own development history and advances independently. Weight anomaly is the one visual tell consistent across all grades.
decisions.decided_text: Four independent refinement axes. (1) Concentration: energy density per unit mass. Advances fastest — economically obvious, industry giants invest heavily. (2) Size: scale of substrate elements from bulk grain through formed geometry to colloidal suspension. Determines apparatus architecture. Drops out as a field variable at personal scale — fixed by component housing at manufacture. (3) Shape: internal geometric coherence of mirror faces within each element. Omnidirectional at primitive end, composite architecture at apex. Degrades under use — two modes: temporary coherence drop under load recovering at rest (rate-of-fire mechanic), permanent accumulation over cycles requiring reprocessing. (4) Matter form: resting phase state before apparatus activation. Solid strained crystal → superheated liquid → supercompressed gas → pre-plasma confinement. Each phase has its own strain equivalent — energy stored in a configuration the material would not naturally occupy, released on apparatus trigger. Orthogonal to the capability arc: affects activation cost and cycle time at any scale but does not determine what scale is reachable. Develops in the refinery, not the apparatus. GRADE PROFILES: Installation bulk — C7 S5 Sh2 MF1, granular fill, mirror flash when disturbed, identifiable by weight and flash. Vehicle precision — C7 S6 Sh6 MF2, formed rods/discs, mirror faces on end surfaces, geometric regularity identifiable to Order operatives. Personal composite — C8 S7 Sh8 MF3, ceramic-like carrier plus sealed liquid ampoule, no exterior mirror faces, defeats casual identification. WEIGHT ANOMALY: consistent across all grades, the one universal tell. FLAGGED: biological barrier interaction at gas phase grades; exotic state convergence as horizon concern.
decisions.session_notes: Four axes developed across multiple sessions this session. Matter form reframed from openness metaphor to phase-state physics — each phase has a strain equivalent. Shape defined as internal face coherence, not orientation relative to apparatus. Size decoupled from shape as independent axis. Matter form held orthogonal to capability arc. Two new open questions flagged: biological barrier at gas phase, exotic state convergence as horizon.

decisions.title: Exotic states of matter beyond plasma
decisions.summary: Theoretically reachable by Coalition research frontier. What are they, and when does the frontier reach them relative to story timeline?

decisions.title: Animal attunement — extent and mechanism
decisions.summary: Wildlife near Vein sites shows field-sensitive behavior. Does this constitute genuine biological attunement? Possibility confirmed; extent and mechanism not established.

decisions.title: Attuned founding figures — revelation timing
decisions.summary: Attuned Coalition members erased from founding records. When does this become known, and to whom? Most consequential narrative revelation.
decisions.decided_text: Founding figures are mythologized in person, deed, and as the attributed source of all institutionally-sanctioned knowledge. The myth absorbs only what the Order chooses to legitimize — selective, not total. New discoveries get retroactively attributed to the founders only when the Order wants to institutionalize them; knowledge that stays in the secret societies or contradicts founding doctrine never enters the myth. Secret societies hold the remainder: unsanctioned accumulated knowledge including material that would erode the myth. The religious arm may hold founding-era records as a possible outcome of its fracture from the families — a negotiated acquisition, not a given; content and completeness uncertain. No single keeper, no active suppression conspiracy — structural distortion accumulated over time through institutional incentives. Discoverable through fragments; no clean revelation required. The gap between what the secret societies know and what the myth contains is itself a map of what the Order declined to legitimize.

decisions.title: Faction final names
decisions.summary: Attuned Order and Forge Coalition are working placeholders. Name when cultures have more shape.

decisions.title: Coalition buried history — has anyone looked?
decisions.summary: Coalition documentary record shows signs of editing. Has anyone in a position to act looked carefully enough to find the inconsistencies?
decisions.decided_text: The Coalition buried history is not institutionally suppressed — no coordinating mechanism exists and no single institution has assembled the full picture. The inconsistencies exist in distributed Coalition records: technical accounts with attribution mismatches, commemorative histories contradicting operational records, founding-era figures who appear and quietly vanish from later documents. No single person or institution has cross-referenced these fragments into a coherent account. The primary barrier is institutional inertia and the wrong questions not being asked, with a secondary layer of political disincentive (a finding that attuned people built the Coalition would destabilize the founding identity). However, important individuals — people connected to celebrated founding figures or powerful families — do quietly protect and suppress specific pieces of the history that touch them, independently and without coordination. The suppression is therefore uneven: some fragments are actively guarded, others sit in archives untouched. This parallels the Order protecting its own history through ambient distortion plus individual interest rather than conspiracy. The Order holds corroborating liberation-era records as military intelligence — documentation of attuned Coalition operatives from the conflict — without framing it as Coalition buried history or knowing the Coalition erased it. Post-liberation, the Order has minimal visibility into Coalition internal life. Cross-referencing Order and Coalition archives would be definitive but requires cross-faction access, which is its own story problem.

decisions.title: Current war trigger
decisions.summary: The current war has a specific cause. What triggered the latest ceasefire collapse?
decisions.decided_text: The current war was triggered by an incident involving five children playing with a degraded Coalition apparatus in genuinely ambiguous territory — implicitly Order-claimed through repeated military dominance, but with Coalition operational history evidenced by the apparatus itself. Three children were Coalition-registered; two were Order-side with no equivalent documentation (the Order has no population census mechanism). Two children were killed: one Coalition, one Order. Both were attuned. The cause was an unknown interaction between the attuned children and the degraded equipment — not an attack, not a patrol encounter, no intent from either side. The Coalition knows exactly who their dead child was through registry records; the Order has no equivalent documentation for theirs. Order amplification: Coalition technology killed attuned children — the religious arm has maximum purchase on this framing. Coalition amplification: Order children (attuned) were present in contested territory — an encroachment narrative that sidesteps the apparatus and their own dead child entirely. The Coalition never officially acknowledged their dead child was attuned; it became a folk rumor in border communities, institutionally invisible but popularly known. The three surviving children hold the buried account: apparatus accident, cross-faction play, no attack. Who seized the opportunity to escalate — founding families, a field commander acting on field autonomy, or the religious arm — is a character-level decision left open. Note: the Order winning confrontations in this territory progressively less easily refers to Coalition apparatus improving, not to the depletion dynamic — these are separate phenomena.

decisions.title: Attunement latent breadth — revelation timing
decisions.summary: When does the revelation that attunement is latent in the broader population occur relative to the story, and who controls that knowledge?
decisions.decided_text: At the story start, attunement latent breadth is not formally known by either faction. The Coalition holds the detectable signal indirectly: attuned people move away from Vein-intense zones as their attunement wakes up, producing migration patterns and demographic flows tracked by regional and local administrators as population movement data. The attunement connection is not labelled in these records. Assembly requires cross-referencing migration patterns against Vein concentration maps and making the interpretive leap that movement away from high-concentration zones is an attunement signal — a cross-disciplinary analytical act nobody has yet performed. The data is distributed across multiple administrative tiers with no single owner. The very top of Coalition leadership may know this analysis is possible without having the assembled picture. A secondary political incentive reinforces the inertia: a formal finding that attunement is broadly distributed would destabilize the Coalition government by undermining the founding purists and the non-attuned identity that holds their coalition together. The Order has no picture at all — their framework attributes attunement to specific bloodlines and their myth structure makes contrary evidence invisible. The revelation path is investigative: the evidence exists, but finding it requires someone with the right framework, access to multiple data sets, and the analytical disposition to make the connection.

decisions.title: Geography — site distribution and physical landscape
decisions.summary: Where are the Vein sites? What separates faction territories? What does the physical landscape of the war look like?
decisions.decided_text: Earth-sized world, one continent in scope. The Vein exists as a geological stratum that surfaces where tectonic uplift, rifting, erosion, or glaciation brings it within workable depth — independent of mountain placement. Concentration at surfacing zones is a function of depth: shallow = high concentration = Coalition territory (biologically hostile to Order); deeper = lower concentration = Order-workable. Seven regions: (1) Western margin — Coalition safe zone, active geology, maritime, high Vein; (2) Southern belt — Coalition safe zone, highest Vein on continent, equatorial/Mediterranean; (3) Contested corridor — L-shaped active war zone (vertical arm NW-SW, horizontal arm SW-SE), depletion boundary that advances as Coalition extracts; (4) Order interior — continental heartland, stable geology, agricultural, Order Vein sites in eastern mountain ranges; (5) Northern territories — arctic/subarctic, Order-claimed but thinly held, religious arm outposts and independent communities fill the vacuum, strategic reserve function; (6) Eastern seaboard — Order-administered scattered coastal settlements, maritimely marginal; (7) SW coastal enclave — Order-claimed but effectively autonomous, largest Order coastal settlement by population but lowest institutional priority, isolated from Order interior by Coalition mountain belt, reaches Order only by sea, faces the Southern Sea. Territory model: blue = Coalition safe zone (not necessarily all governed); orange = Order operational range (not necessarily all governed). The front is a depletion boundary, not a static political line.
decisions.session_notes: Sites are not just locations — they produce social structures around them. The company-town dynamic from D024 is the model to extend. Geography should be built with environment-as-active-force in mind: Vein site concentration shapes settlement pattern, labor relations, folk culture, and military priority simultaneously.

decisions.title: Third parties and neutral populations
decisions.summary: Are there people or groups outside the two main factions — neutral territories, a third party, displaced populations within each faction's borders?
decisions.decided_text:
True neutrality does not exist in this world. Any territory worth inhabiting is Vein-adjacent or dependent on those who are; the ideological conflict has no neutral position. What exists instead are six types of peripheral actors — none neutral, all implicated, none fitting cleanly into either faction's framework.

Types are defined by their origin condition, not by faction attachment. Faction relationship is a starting point and a live tension, not an identity.

1. Administratively abandoned — populations inside a faction's claimed territory the faction never seriously governed. A governance vacuum that produces its own internal hierarchy over time. Present on both sides.

2. Ideologically expelled — populations excluded by a faction's founding logic. The Coalition expels attuned who contradict its identity; the Order expels non-attuned who don't fit its hierarchy. Identity is built in the gap, not inherited from the origin faction.

3. Geographic ungoverned / proto-state — terrain or distance makes administration unviable. Given enough time, governance vacuums develop their own coercive authority. The Order's 'strategic reserve' assumption about the north may be wrong.

4. Maritime communities — neither faction built the infrastructure to govern them. Mobility and institutional illegibility are their protection, not strength.

5. Extractive networks — operate in the shadow economy of both factions. Move material: Vein substrate, refined states, apparatus components outside official channels. Structural interest in the conflict continuing (war creates the price differentials they exploit).

6. Conflict entrepreneurs — move conditions rather than material. Arms supply, recruitment financing, information that prolongs the war. Don't need a commodity; need the conflict to stay hot.

Rauta's axis (proxy / auxiliary / surrogate / affiliated) describes the relationship each type has to the main factions at any given moment — not a fixed property but a live negotiation that shifts with the war's momentum.

Stedman classification: types 1-2 are limited spoilers (specific achievable goals); type 3 is a potential total spoiler (existence depends on Order not reasserting control); types 4-6 are greedy spoilers (extract maximum value, structurally benefit from non-resolution).

Geographic placement of specific instances is handled in D013 — sites produce social structures, and the map determines where each type can plausibly exist.

decisions.title: Coalition apparatus — core mechanism
decisions.summary: The mechanical means by which non-attuned people hold substrate open, active, and extractable without attunement. Foundation of Coalition civilization. Full development arc decided including Phase 3. Requires WORLD.md apparatus section write-in.
decisions.decided_text: CORE ARCHITECTURE: Four-layer structure. (1) Substrate chamber: inner lining of silicate or oxide Vein-phase (holds substrate in high-energy state, performs containment and partial conduction simultaneously); outer housing of granite at site scale, porcelain at component scale (active field resistance). Mechanical pressure system holds substrate open against closure tendency — this is the founding engineering problem of early apparatus, the hardest component to build, and the thing the Order cannot replicate because attunement does it directly. Chamber geometry designed for controlled fracture propagation. (2) Thermal extraction: copper conduit network drawing field-induced heat from chamber; bronze damping stages between high-intensity and low-intensity sections; lead thermal fuses at critical overload points. (3) Useful work output: two apparatus configurations serving different purposes, neither primary. Steam-pressure configuration (apparatus as boiler — field energy heats water in copper conduit network, steam drives mechanical work, factory aesthetic). Direct-heat configuration (apparatus as forge — field energy delivered as concentrated heat to specific location via copper conduit, processing and smelting aesthetic). Both configurations use identical core architecture; the difference is what the copper conduit network terminates into. (4) Operator interface: quartz transducer array for field intensity measurement; indicator panel (tin for threshold crossing, pyrite for accumulation, glass for time-to-failure, mercury for field direction and intensity); mechanical controls for pressure, cooling rate, extraction rate. No direct field manipulation — all controls are material-state controls. Operators read material behavior, not field state. OPERATING PRINCIPLE: The apparatus does not control the field directly. It creates material conditions where substrate is held open mechanically, field energy conducts into metal and expresses as heat, heat is extracted as useful work, excess energy bleeds into Vein-phase linings, and the system fails gracefully through lead fuses under overload. OPERATOR EXPERTISE: Indicator literacy is the Coalition's mastery gradient. A novice reads individual indicators. An expert reads the full array — quartz transducer output, tin threshold state, pyrite accumulation, glass progression, mercury surface — as a unified field-state picture. The gap between novice and expert operator is the same structural gap as between novice and master Order practitioner, expressed through a completely different medium. WHY INFERIOR TO ORDER (Phase 1-2): Slow (mechanical response times vs. instant attunement), coarse (bulk extraction only, no fine-grained manipulation), scale-dependent (apparatus grows huge at high intensity), inflexible (changing operation requires rebuilding geometry — cannot pivot mid-operation). DEVELOPMENT ARC: Phase 1 — passive (development period). Substrate held open by mechanical pressure. Energy harvested purely through thermal extraction. Indicators empirically discovered through material failure patterns. Mercury as the measurement breakthrough — converts empirical tinkering into a readable, controllable system; the transition from craft to systematic science. Phase 2 — active (liberation war era). Quartz transducer arrays added for real-time field measurement. Feedback-controlled mechanical systems responding to transducer readings. Still no direct field manipulation, but active response to field state. Phase 3 — combined (current era research frontier). The transducer array achieves both forward and reverse transduction simultaneously: forward (quartz receiving field energy as mechanical signal — perception), reverse (mechanical stress on quartz producing directed field perturbation — expression). The system measures, perturbs, measures the response, and adjusts — a feedback loop that approaches attunement through a completely different mechanism. HARD CEILING: The Coalition combined system operates at the speed of mechanical systems, not biological ones. An Order master perceives the field continuously and adjusts in real time. The Coalition system samples, computes, and actuates in discrete steps. At low intensity and large scale the gap is negligible — Coalition apparatus matches or exceeds Order capability. At high intensity and fine grain it is the difference between surgery and a sledgehammer. The Coalition excels at industrial scale. The Order excels at human scale. Neither obsoletes the other. STRATEGIC CONSEQUENCE: The Phase 3 system does not make extraction infrastructure obsolete in the way distributed electricity would — you still need the sites, still need the substrate, still interact with it through apparatus. What it makes obsolete is uncontrolled passive extraction infrastructure specifically. The industry giants are not protecting against replacement; they are protecting against restructuring, which is a subtler and more defensible position. The Coalition is on a path to matching Order capability at scale while remaining permanently inferior at the individual human level — which reframes the war from 'can we ever match them' to 'we already match them where it matters strategically, and they know it.'
decisions.session_notes: Useful work output decided as both-equal with different apparatus configurations. Phase 3 decided as dual-mode transducer feedback loop with mechanical speed as the hard ceiling. The ceiling is load-bearing — it is what prevents either side from achieving permanent decisive advantage and what makes the current war unresolvable by capability alone. The founding engineering problem (mechanical pressure system) should be foregrounded in WORLD.md as the hardest problem, not listed as one component among equals. Refactor flag: write Coalition apparatus section into WORLD.md before next session.

decisions.title: Order institutional age and deep history timeline
decisions.summary: Determines whether desensitization is biological (requires deep time) or cultural/technical (centuries sufficient). Do not resolve desensitization mechanism until this is decided.
decisions.decided_text: The Order is approximately two thousand years old at the story start. The founding coincides with the founding catastrophe — the events that established the institutional ceiling. Stagnation across two millennia is produced by interlocking mechanisms: cyclical knowledge loss through embodied transmission failure (gains and losses roughly cancel across generations); founding families suppressing innovation that would redistribute power; the secret societies absorbing the most capable non-conformists into power maintenance rather than discovery; absence of competitive pressure for most of the Order history (the Coalition is the first serious threat in two thousand years). Desensitization is biological: the institutional ceiling has constrained practice for two thousand years, and heritable attunement capacity that is never exercised gradually reduces across enough generations through ordinary heritable trait dynamics. Founding-era practitioners had access to exotic states current practitioners cannot reliably reach — not because the founders were uniquely exceptional (as the myth claims) but because the ceiling has biologically compounded into reduced average capacity. Secret societies preserve exotic state knowledge as the institutional memory of capabilities the general Order population can no longer access without deliberate cultivation. Rough timeline: founding catastrophe and Order establishment ~2000 years ago; bloodline consolidation over several centuries in mid-history (specific era deferred to D020); pre-conflict era within the last several centuries; liberation 8-10 generations ago (~250-300 years); current era.

decisions.title: Tech timeline — normal branch vs Vein branch
decisions.summary: Where does the story present sit on the real-world tech timeline for (A) general Coalition technology and (B) Vein-specific technology? Is the gap between them visible and legible to people in the world?
decisions.session_notes: Decision 2 — not yet answered. Pending after materials session. Decided. Flagged for revisit.
decisions.decided_text: Part A: general Coalition technology sits between early industrial and inter-war. Iron/steel construction, coal-dominant, early internal combustion emerging, rail as backbone, bolt-action military, no antibiotics, telegraph/early telephone. Part B: Vein track is ahead in materials science, energy, and precision instrumentation — concentrated at extraction sites, not distributed. Vein currently functions as located depletable fuel not distributed power. The research frontier is pursuing a transition toward something electricity-like but that transition is a threat hanging over the story, not an event within it. Part C: gap is visible and partially legible — ordinary citizens experience texture difference, Order observers see it clearly, industry giants and researchers experience it as active political fault line. REVISIT: all three parts flagged for eventual revision as world develops.

decisions.title: Materials — Vein-adjacent mineral phases
decisions.summary: Vein sites contain real-world mineral compounds in unusual structural phases formed under persistent field conditions. Not new elements — same periodic table. These phases are stable only in field proximity and transition toward ordinary stable phases when removed. Substrate remains singular. This is Decision 1 from the materials session.
decisions.decided_text: The world contains no new elements. Vein-adjacent minerals are real-world compounds in high-energy crystalline phases that formed under and persist in field conditions. Remove from field proximity and they slowly revert. The apparatus may be built from or lined with these materials.

decisions.title: Materials — full Vein effect taxonomy by material category
decisions.summary: How the field interacts with each major material category, with variation along material properties within each category. Current session focus — blocked on tech timeline decision.
decisions.decided_text: Framework: three axes — conductivity, state-change threshold, failure mode/role. Full profiles decided for all story-present materials across seven categories: metals (ferrous and non-ferrous, including mercury as primary detection material), Vein-adjacent phases (silicate, oxide, sulfide, carbonate), insulators (granite, porcelain, terracotta, rubber, tar), transducer materials (quartz, tourmaline, beryl, bone), detection/indicator materials (glass, obsidian, pyrite), carbon forms (charcoal, graphite, diamond), and one-liner entries for all remaining story-present materials. Content lives in working/MATERIALS_BASELINE.md; WORLD.md links out to it. Write-debt into WORLD.md resolved by keeping MATERIALS_BASELINE as the canonical material reference with links from the three relevant WORLD.md sections.

decisions.title: Bloodline consolidation mechanism
decisions.summary: How was genealogical rewriting coordinated at scale? Implies organizational continuity that sits in tension with founding families as a shifting coalition. Resolve alongside D016.

decisions.title: Vein first discovery — what did the development population observe
decisions.summary: What secondary effect was legible enough to trigger investigation before anyone had instruments or attunement? Must be observable to non-attuned people during ordinary life in Vein-dense territory.
decisions.decided_text: Three-stage discovery arc. (1) First signal — phosphorus glow. White phosphorus compounds near active substrate produce cold light at night: field-accelerated oxidation, no combustion, no instruments, no attunement required. Passive and geographic — it happens whether or not anyone acts. Will-o-the-wisp phenomena concentrated near Vein sites draw the development-period population to investigate specific locations. The 'something is here.' (2) First manipulation — metal behavior. Metal tools and structures near substrate behave anomalously: warming without fire, conducting heat in the wrong direction, responding to proximity to the ground. Crude field direction becomes possible before anyone has theory. Empirical tinkering with metal rods as field directors. The 'I can do something with it.' (3) Measurement breakthrough — mercury. Someone already working with early apparatus notices mercury behaves anomalously near active substrate: surface tension response, directional behavior. Mercury converts early apparatus from directed thermal effect into a readable, controllable system. The transition from empirical tinkering to systematic science. This stage is a development-period discovery, not a pre-framework one — it requires already knowing something is worth working with.
decisions.session_notes: Mercury considered as co-discovery candidate for first signal but rejected: mercury behavior requires already having mercury in the right configuration and watching it carefully. It is a mining product, not common surface geology. Wrong order for a first signal. Mercury is instead the measurement-layer unlock — the material that makes the field legible as a system rather than a phenomenon.

decisions.title: Specific faction atrocities
decisions.summary: What specific atrocities has each side committed, and how does each faction officially relate to them?
decisions.session_notes: Founding catastrophe layer written into WORLD.md (draft 76). Established: event was a period not a single event; staggered triggers (deliberate push, ignorant experimentation); victims were everyone in affected regions; consequences include famines/displacement/plagues/desertification/climate extremes. Five residual dimensions at abstraction level: (A) geological scarring of Vein expression in affected zones, (B) biological residue in survivor descendants possibly feeding attunement distribution, (C) knowledge contamination sealed in religious archives, (E) dead attunement zones on the map, (F) long-tail field exposure misread as disease. Still open: the three original questions (Suppression scale, Verification endpoint, inter-war period) plus the full atrocity registry beyond the founding event.

decisions.title: Daily life — ordinary people on each side
decisions.summary: What does daily life look like beneath the level of the elite on each side?
decisions.session_notes: The asymmetry with the Order is the key gap: Order has the Vein as intimate bodily infrastructure (religion, folk belief, social hierarchy all flow from attunement). Coalition has it at industrial and political scale but the ordinary person's daily relationship to the Vein is underdeveloped. D023 needs to close this — not just civilian routine but how the Vein is present or absent in Coalition daily experience.

decisions.title: Industry giants — full operational picture
decisions.summary: Three-layer organizational structure (trade association, dynasty family network, shared bank), negative coordination, generational time horizon, archive asymmetry, regional economic dependency as constitutional leverage, three-tier sabotage operations (soft/gray/dark), violence accessed through site security and contractor chains.
decisions.decided_text: Industry giants operate through three conventional layers (trade association, dynasty family network, shared bank) and four unconventional mechanisms (negative coordination/veto network, time horizon mismatch as patience strategy, archive asymmetry from private operational records, mutual vulnerability equilibrium). Violence is not a standing capacity but is accessed through site security (gray-zone direct layer), a contractor chain (multiple steps removed), and a problem manager per major operation who interfaces between the two without letting them touch. Regional influence is structural through economic dependency; constitutional court influence is indirect through federalism questions (narrow federal authority, broad regional authority). Section written into WORLD.md draft 74.

decisions.title: Secret societies — full operational picture
decisions.summary: Internal hierarchy, recruitment, inter-member knowledge, communication across Order branches, relationship to founding catastrophe history. Develop before character work involving them.

decisions.title: Quartz / crystalline transducer property
decisions.summary: The field-mechanical bidirectional transducer property exists in this world as an analogue to real-world piezoelectricity. Quartz and the crystalline gem family convert between field energy and mechanical energy in both directions. Quartz is the democratized version (everywhere), tourmaline the high-performance rare version. This is the only bidirectional transducer in the taxonomy — all other materials are one-way.
decisions.decided_text: Field-mechanical transduction property confirmed. Quartz vibrates in response to field energy; mechanical stress on quartz near active substrate perturbs the field. Effect scales with crystalline order — quartz baseline, tourmaline stronger, beryl weak. Development-period population interacted with field through quartz accidentally before any framework existed.

decisions.title: Bone piezoelectricity and attunement mechanism
decisions.summary: Real-world bone piezoelectricity carries into the world. Living bone in attuned practitioners is part of the attunement mechanism — not just neurological coupling structures but physical skeletal resonance. The body is the antenna; the neurology is the interpreter. Non-attuned people have the same piezoelectric bone but no neurological coupling to read the signal.
decisions.decided_text: Attunement is not purely neurological. Skeletal and connective tissue participate as the physical antenna — piezoelectric structures that resonate with the field. Neurological structures interpret the signal. Non-attuned people receive the mechanical signal without translation. Weak latent attunement is partial neurological coupling — signal arrives, nothing translates it.

decisions.title: Blood composite field pathway — overexposure mechanism
decisions.summary: Blood carries two simultaneous field pathways: water (thermal) and iron via hemoglobin (metal conduction). At low intensity water pathway dominates. At medium intensity iron pathway becomes significant, affecting hemoglobin's oxygen-carrying function directly. This is the material-level account of overexposure damage in attuned practitioners.
decisions.decided_text: Blood has composite field behavior — water thermal pathway and iron metal-conduction pathway active simultaneously. Healing at low intensity works through water pathway. Higher intensity activates iron pathway, affecting hemoglobin directly. The threshold between healing and a specific form of internal damage is an intensity distinction experienced practitioners learn and novices often don't know exists.

decisions.title: Metal field conduction — storage, distance, and geometry
decisions.summary: Three open questions on metal field conduction settled as pre-apparatus baseline. Metal is a pure conductor with no field storage; conduction losses are geometry-dependent rather than distance-dependent; geometry is the primary variable governing conduction efficiency and failure point location.
decisions.decided_text: (1) Metal stores no field energy. It conducts and releases while the source is active; remove the source and the conduction stops. No portable charge, no residual field in worked metal. Preserves the located-fuel model. (2) Conduction does not degrade linearly with distance. It degrades at geometric complexity: joints, bends, welds, thin cross-sections, and direction changes are where intensity drops and failure initiates. A straight run conducts efficiently at any practical apparatus length; a complex path loses intensity at each geometric transition. (3) Geometry is the primary conduction variable. Cross-section, bend angle, junction type, and surface area all affect field efficiency through a metal structure. This is why Vein-phase oxide mineral — which can be formed into geometries wrought metal cannot achieve — is the source of the site apparatus precision gap: complex internal routing that copper and iron cannot form at this tech level.

decisions.title: Material-state intelligence — apparatus condition as tradecraft
decisions.summary: Apparatus installations cannot conceal their operational history from anyone who knows how to read material condition. Indicator wear patterns, thermal stress accumulation, and replacement traces are intelligence. Both Coalition inspection doctrine and Order field operative training are built on this principle.
decisions.decided_text: Material condition is harder to falsify than documentation because every replacement leaves its own trace. Glass indicators accumulate a continuous stress record readable as operational history. Pyrite accumulation inconsistent with logs means either falsification or unreported activity. Replaced lead fuses more recent than maintenance records indicate overload events being concealed. Coalition formal inspection protocols are built on this principle. Order field operatives read Coalition site material condition as tactical intelligence — indicator wear maps operational priorities, recently pushed installations are distinguishable from idle ones, and discrepancies between expected and actual wear reveal either inactive sites or active concealment. The glass indicator panel is the most readable because its failure mode is progressive rather than threshold-crossing: it records a continuous history rather than flipping states. Absence of expected wear on old components is as informative as presence of unexpected wear on new ones.

decisions.title: Energy conservation as first principle
decisions.summary: The Vein does not generate energy. It is a finite geological concentration of energy that accumulated over vast timescales. Every interaction with the Vein is energy moving — between states, between locations, between the stored concentration and the world drawing from it. Energy is never created or destroyed, only moved, concentrated, or dispersed. Both factions draw from the same finite reservoir; both contribute to its depletion, the Coalition faster and at greater volume, the Order more slowly and precisely, neither exempt from the physics.

decisions.title: Embodied vs. infrastructural as the permanent asymmetry
decisions.summary: The Coalition's capability is always infrastructural — it requires apparatus, supply chains, installation, and support. The Order's capability is always embodied — it lives in the practitioner's biology and moves with them. The Coalition can eventually approximate any capability the Order has, but always at greater size, weight, logistical cost, and deployment time. The Order's advantage is not what they can do but where they can do it and how fast. Neither makes the other obsolete. This asymmetry is permanent — not a current gap but a structural consequence of how each faction accesses the Vein.

decisions.title: Coalition capability development arc
decisions.summary: Coalition capabilities tend to develop in sequence from fixed installation through vehicular to personal scale. The stationary installation is typically the most powerful instance; the personal version is the least powerful but most deployable. This is a strong tendency, not an absolute rule — exceptions exist and are valid when they have good reasons. Every contradiction of the arc should be examined: if a Coalition capability reaches personal scale before installation scale, or skips a stage, that needs an explanation grounded in the specific physics or economics of that capability. The arc reflects the Coalition's fundamental infrastructural nature and the weight-budget problem that miniaturization always imposes.

decisions.title: Cross-faction encounters — Order occupation and prisoner doctrine
decisions.summary: Full cross-faction encounter doctrine for both sides — occupation priorities, prisoner handling, interrogation culture, indoctrination pipeline, and folk encounter psychology. Contact prohibition scope resolved by D035: prohibition targets Order non-attuned civilians primarily; stayers are self-selected so risk is confirmation of suppressed doubt, not first exposure.
decisions.decided_text: ORDER OCCUPATION: Priority is apparatus dismantling — felt as restoration, not conquest. Three institutional interests compete over detained apparatus operators without coordinating: military (tactical intel), secret societies (deep Vein knowledge), families/religious arm (destroy the machines). KILLING OF APPARATUS ARCHITECTS: varies by political compass — doctrinal commanders kill as righteous or policy action, pragmatic commanders delay for extraction. Gap between capture and death is character territory. CONTACT PROHIBITION: doctrinal goal is total prohibition between Order non-attuned and Coalition civilians. Feasibility blocked on D035 (Order demographics). COALITION INTERROGATION: no single character — varies by which institution has custody. Military: operational intel, time-pressured, coercion when clock runs out, collapses on witnessing capability. Scientific: technical debriefing register, fascination over anxiety, susceptible to practitioner managing the exchange. Industrial: site knowledge, transactional, sustained pressure over time. Senior practitioners are contested across all three institutions, mirroring Order's three-institution conflict over apparatus operators. COALITION PRISONER DOCTRINE: attuned prisoners are long-term intelligence assets. Non-attuned prisoners get indoctrination pipeline — pitch is 'wrong side of the same divide we fought to end,' contact prohibition becomes evidence within the pitch. Success rate ~1 in 5, tracks with whether prisoner experienced the prohibition as active constraint and whether they hit the attunement ceiling. Converts absorbed at lower institutional tiers, permanently monitored, generational trust. Non-converts split: exchange, detention, or deliberately released carrying their exposure. FOLK ENCOUNTER PSYCHOLOGY: Order non-attuned vs Coalition civilians — ordinary humanity doesn't fit the abstraction, what leaks is evidence not argument. Order attuned vs Coalition infrastructure — scale produces cognitive dissonance the Order's doctrine provides no script for. Coalition vs practitioners — inferiority register intensifies on contact, not resolves; Coalition has no official vocabulary for what witnesses come back with. Coalition vs Order non-attuned — most disorienting; person doesn't fit the liberation-narrative role they were supposed to occupy.

decisions.title: Order population demographics — attuned vs non-attuned ratio
decisions.summary: Population demographics decided for three time points. Pre-liberation Order: 30% attuned / 70% non-attuned — classic minority rule, the non-attuned majority provided the liberation's demographic base. Current Order: 70% attuned / 30% non-attuned — the departure inverted the composition; attuned majority is produced by selective retention, not a pre-existing condition. Current Coalition: 5% attuned / 95% non-attuned — founding identity holds demographically; 5% traces to liberation-era Order defectors plus accumulated spontaneous emergence. Attuned lineage transmission within established Order families: ~70-80%.
decisions.decided_text: Pre-liberation Order: ~30% attuned / 70% non-attuned. Classic minority-rule structure — the conditions for the liberation were produced by this demographic. Current Order: ~70% attuned / 30% non-attuned. The liberation's mass departure transformed composition. The non-attuned 30% who remain are self-selected stayers — embedded in attuned families, ideologically captured, or born after the split. Not naive about the Coalition; contact prohibition risk is confirmation of suppressed doubt, not first exposure. The Order narrativizes the shift as clarification. Current Coalition: ~5% attuned / 95% non-attuned. Coalition founding identity holds demographically. The 5% attuned traces to liberation-era Order defectors plus accumulating spontaneous emergence. Outskirts communities at this scale have their own culture and grievances; geographic marginalization strategy built for smaller numbers is under pressure. Attuned lineage transmission within established Order families: ~70-80%. High enough that the bloodline narrative feels internally accurate — attuned parents produce attuned children as the reliable outcome, non-attuned children as the exception requiring management. Transmission failures are the source population for the internal underclass.

decisions.title: Gas-phase substrate and biological barrier interaction
decisions.summary: At high matter form grades (supercompressed gas phase and above), can refined substrate recreate ambient field intensity equivalent to a natural high-concentration site? If yes, Coalition personal apparatus could deny Order practitioners operational access at engagement range — potentially contradicting the Order-excels-at-human-scale invariant. If no, apparatus contains and directs field expression rather than radiating it ambiently. Flagged in D005 session notes and WORLD.md open questions. Related but distinct from D006 (exotic states): D006 asks what exotic states are and when the frontier reaches them; this asks whether gas-phase substrate affects the territorial logic that structures the war.

decisions.title: Religious arm — full operational picture
decisions.summary: Internal hierarchy, recruitment and advancement mechanics, what the arm actually holds from the founding era (D008 left this as 'possible' with content uncertain), what senior figures want independently of the founding families, how the arm operates in the northern territories. The religious arm is the least developed of the Order's four institutional branches and the one with the most direct story leverage — it carried the war trigger framing (D011) and maintains the institutional ceiling doctrine. Parallel to D025 (secret societies operational picture). Resolve before character work involving Order religious figures.

decisions.title: Vein overexposure — external presentation
decisions.summary: What do observers see when a practitioner is being harmed by the field? The internal mechanism (blood composite pathway, permanent vs temporary degradation) is established. The external presentation — visible symptoms, behavioral changes, what it looks like to bystanders — is not. Needed before writing scenes where overexposure is witnessed.
